lessons: Every outage here was silent degradation. Ship the failure signal in the same PR as the integration.
Never pass secrets as plaintext env to Cloud Run; deploy-cloud-run.ps1 now hard-fails without Secret Manager refs.
A CHECK constraint cannot reference a parent table; enforce cross-table rules with AFTER UPDATE triggers.
Netlify `ignore` exit 0 means CANCEL the deploy.
Partition names are a cross-repo contract; truth_audit gate partition-contract enforces it.
